resources.string: USB devices
Manage Native iPhone and Userspace Linux USB access
Native/Userspace Linux: terminal-usb list, iphone, tooling. Userspace Linux also supports serial/adb/mtp/raw (Python 3 required). Approve here and rerun. Choose folders under Removable storage.
